aboutPage.title: Who Are We?
aboutPage.sub: A family company from Entre Ríos with a clear purpose: democratize healthy eating.
aboutPage.story1: Entrenuts was born with a simple idea: make eating well a pleasure, not a sacrifice. From Colón, Entre Ríos, we create natural products that combine real ingredients with genuine flavor.
aboutPage.story2: Today our products are found in Argentina's main supermarket chains. We remain a family company, with the same commitment as always: quality, honesty, and flavor.
aboutPage.val1Text: No artificial additives or preservatives. Only what nature has to offer.
aboutPage.val2Text: We believe eating well should not be a luxury. That's why we create products accessible to everyone.
aboutPage.val3Text: Local production, national suppliers, and the pride of the pampas.
aboutPage.presenceSub: Find Entrenuts in Argentina's leading supermarket chains.
